title: Travel
description: Get from one place to another and ask for help doing it.

questions.sentence: Aap kahan ja rahe hain?
options: Main station ja raha hoon.
Main bus mein baitha hoon.
Main abhi ghar par hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main station ja raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to the station.

questions.sentence: Yeh bus kahan jati hai?
options: Yeh bus Lucknow jati hai.
Yeh bus abhi nahin aayi.
Yeh train Hyderabad jati hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Yeh bus Lucknow jati hai.
questions.translatedSentence: This bus goes to Lucknow.

questions.sentence: Station kahan hai?
options: Where is the station?
Where is the bus?
Is the station far?
questions.correctAnswer: Where is the station?

questions.sentence: Station yahan se door hai?
options: Nahin, station qareeb hai.
Haan, bus abhi khadi hai.
Nahin, mujhe chai chahiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, station qareeb hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No, the station is close by.

questions.sentence: Bus abhi nahin aayi.
options: The bus has not come yet.
The bus has already left.
The bus is very full.
questions.correctAnswer: The bus has not come yet.

questions.sentence: Kya yeh train Delhi jati hai?
options: Haan, yeh train Delhi jati hai.
Haan, mujhe train pasand hai.
Nahin, station bahut bada hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, yeh train Delhi jati hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this train goes to Delhi.

questions.sentence: Train das baje jati hai.
options: The train leaves at ten o'clock.
The train arrives at nine o'clock.
The train is late today.
questions.correctAnswer: The train leaves at ten o'clock.

questions.sentence: Aap bus se ja rahe hain ya train se?
options: Main train se ja raha hoon.
Main station par khada hoon.
Main Delhi mein rehta hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Main train se ja raha hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going by train.

questions.sentence: Main Hyderabad ja rahi hoon.
options: I am going to Hyderabad.
I am coming from Hyderabad.
I live in Hyderabad.
questions.correctAnswer: I am going to Hyderabad.

questions.sentence: Aap ko kitne ticket chahiye?
options: Mujhe do ticket chahiye.
Mujhe train ka waqt maloom nahin.
Main khirki par khada hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mujhe do ticket chahiye.
questions.translatedSentence: I need two tickets.

questions.sentence: Lucknow ka ticket kitne ka hai?
options: Teen sau rupay ka hai.
Ticket khirki par milta hai.
Lucknow yahan se door hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Teen sau rupay ka hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It costs three hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Karachi ka ek ticket chahiye.
options: I need one ticket to Karachi.
I want to go to Karachi tomorrow.
I already have a ticket to Karachi.
questions.correctAnswer: I need one ticket to Karachi.

questions.sentence: Agli train kitne baje hai?
options: Agli train shaam paanch baje hai.
Ticket khirki abhi band hai.
Yeh train platform do par khadi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Agli train shaam paanch baje hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The next train is at five in the evening.

questions.sentence: Yeh ticket kal ke liye hai.
options: This ticket is for tomorrow.
This ticket is only for today.
This ticket is not valid.
questions.correctAnswer: This ticket is for tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Kya aaj ki train mein jagah hai?
options: Haan, do seat khali hain.
Haan, ticket khirki khuli hai.
Nahin, station door nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, do seat khali hain.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, two seats are free.

questions.sentence: Train aadhe ghante mein aayegi.
options: The train will arrive in half an hour.
The train left half an hour ago.
The train comes every half hour.
questions.correctAnswer: The train will arrive in half an hour.

questions.sentence: Ticket khirki kahan hai?
options: Khirki station ke andar hai.
Ticket teen sau rupay ka hai.
Train abhi nikal rahi hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Khirki station ke andar hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The ticket window is inside the station.

questions.sentence: Kya main yahan se ticket khareed sakta hoon?
options: Can I buy a ticket here?
Where can I buy a ticket?
Should I buy the ticket now?
questions.correctAnswer: Can I buy a ticket here?

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, bazaar kis taraf hai?
options: Seedhe jaiye, phir daayen mudiye.
Bazaar aaj bahut bhara hua hai.
Bazaar mein achhi biryani milti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Seedhe jaiye, phir daayen mudiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Go straight, then turn right.

questions.sentence: Kya yeh raasta station ko jata hai?
options: Nahin, yeh raasta bazaar ko jata hai.
Haan, yeh sadak nayi bani hai.
Nahin, station das baje khulta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, yeh raasta bazaar ko jata hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No, this road goes to the market.

questions.sentence: Seedhe chaliye aur baayen mudiye.
options: Go straight and turn left.
Turn right at the corner.
Walk to the end of this road.
questions.correctAnswer: Go straight and turn left.

questions.sentence: Yahan se hospital kitni door hai?
options: Sirf paanch minute ka raasta hai.
Hospital subah nau baje khulta hai.
Wahan achhi dawa mil jati hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Sirf paanch minute ka raasta hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It is only a five-minute walk.

questions.sentence: Mujhe yeh raasta maloom nahin hai.
options: I do not know this road.
This road is not open.
I have not walked much today.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not know this road.

questions.sentence: Kya main wahan paidal ja sakta hoon?
options: Haan, paidal jaana hi behtar hai.
Haan, wahan gaari khadi hai.
Nahin, mujhe raasta maloom hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, paidal jaana hi behtar hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it is better to walk there.

questions.sentence: Woh dukan sadak ke doosri taraf hai.
options: That shop is on the other side of the road.
That shop is at the end of the road.
That shop is right next to the market.
questions.correctAnswer: That shop is on the other side of the road.

questions.sentence: Zara batayiye, masjid kahan hai?
options: Masjid us mor ke baad hai.
Masjid ki imaarat bahut purani hai.
Masjid mein log jama ho rahe hain.
questions.correctAnswer: Masjid us mor ke baad hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The mosque is just after that turn.

questions.sentence: Bank chowk ke qareeb hai.
options: The bank is near the crossroads.
The bank is behind the crossroads.
The bank is opposite the market.
questions.correctAnswer: The bank is near the crossroads.

questions.sentence: Bhai sahab, kya aap purane shehar chalenge?
options: Haan, baith jaiye.
Haan, mera auto naya hai.
Nahin, mujhe raasta maloom nahin tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, baith jaiye.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please get in.

questions.sentence: Station tak ka kiraya kitna loge?
options: Do sau rupay lunga.
Station yahan se qareeb nahin.
Meter par abhi kuch nahin likha.
questions.correctAnswer: Do sau rupay lunga.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take two hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Meter chalu kar dijiye.
options: Please start the meter.
Please stop the meter.
The meter is not working.
questions.correctAnswer: Please start the meter.

questions.sentence: Kya aap meter se chalenge?
options: Haan, main meter se hi chalta hoon.
Haan, yeh sadak seedhi jati hai.
Nahin, auto bazaar ke qareeb khada hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main meter se hi chalta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I go only by the meter.

questions.sentence: Auto se jaana taxi se sasta hai.
options: Going by auto is cheaper than by taxi.
The auto is faster than the taxi.
The taxi costs more than the bus.
questions.correctAnswer: Going by auto is cheaper than by taxi.

questions.sentence: Kiraya kuch kam kar lijiye.
options: Theek hai, ek sau assi de dijiye.
Theek hai, main yahin rok deta hoon.
Kiraya khirki par likha hua hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, ek sau assi de dijiye.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, give me one hundred and eighty.

questions.sentence: Mujhe Charminar tak jaana hai.
options: I need to go to Charminar.
I have just come from Charminar.
I want to see Charminar tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I need to go to Charminar.

questions.sentence: Zara yahan rok dijiye.
options: Theek hai, main yahan rokta hoon.
Theek hai, meter do sau bata raha hai.
Haan, taxi bhi mil jayegi.
questions.correctAnswer: Theek hai, main yahan rokta hoon.
questions.translatedSentence: All right, I will stop here.

questions.sentence: Agle chowk par rok dena.
options: Stop at the next crossroads.
Turn at the next crossroads.
Wait for me at the crossroads.
questions.correctAnswer: Stop at the next crossroads.

questions.sentence: Kya aap ke paas ek kamra khali hai?
options: Haan, doosri manzil par ek kamra khali hai.
Haan, hotel station ke qareeb hai.
Nahin, nashta subah milta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, doosri manzil par ek kamra khali hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, there is a free room on the second floor.

questions.sentence: Aap kitni raat rukenge?
options: Main do raat rukunga.
Main kal subah pahuncha tha.
Mujhe yeh kamra pasand aaya.
questions.correctAnswer: Main do raat rukunga.
questions.translatedSentence: I will stay for two nights.

questions.sentence: Mujhe aisa kamra chahiye jis mein khirki ho.
options: I need a room that has a window.
I need a room with two beds.
I would like to see the room first.
questions.correctAnswer: I need a room that has a window.

questions.sentence: Ek raat ka kiraya kitna hai?
options: Ek raat ka pandrah sau rupay hai.
Kamra teesri manzil par hai.
Kamre mein garam paani aata hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ek raat ka pandrah sau rupay hai.
questions.translatedSentence: One night costs fifteen hundred rupees.

questions.sentence: Kamra saaf hai lekin thora chhota hai.
options: The room is clean but a little small.
The room is small but very cheap.
The room is clean and quite big.
questions.correctAnswer: The room is clean but a little small.

questions.sentence: Kya kamre mein garam paani aata hai?
options: Haan, subah aur raat ko garam paani aata hai.
Haan, kamra kaafi bada hai.
Nahin, lift kaam nahin kar rahi.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, subah aur raat ko garam paani aata hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, hot water comes in the morning and at night.

questions.sentence: Agar kamra pasand na aaya to main doosra dekh lunga.
options: If I do not like the room, I will look at another one.
If the room is expensive, I will stay somewhere else.
I liked the room, but I will look at another one.
questions.correctAnswer: If I do not like the room, I will look at another one.

questions.sentence: Nashta kitne baje milta hai?
options: Nashta saat se das baje tak milta hai.
Nashte mein chai bhi shaamil hai.
Khana neeche wale kamre mein milta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Nashta saat se das baje tak milta hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Breakfast is served from seven until ten.

questions.sentence: Meherbani kar ke mera saamaan kamre tak pahuncha dijiye.
options: Please have my luggage sent up to the room.
Please keep my luggage down here for now.
Please bring my luggage down from the room.
questions.correctAnswer: Please have my luggage sent up to the room.

questions.sentence: Train kitni der se aa rahi hai?
options: Train do ghante late hai kyunki aage patri par kaam ho raha hai.
Train waqt par nikli thi lekin main pahunch nahin saka.
Train ka ticket khirki se lena parta hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Train do ghante late hai kyunki aage patri par kaam ho raha hai.
questions.translatedSentence: The train is two hours late because there is work going on the track ahead.

questions.sentence: Aap ka saamaan kaisa dikhta hai?
options: Woh ek kala bag hai jis par mera naam likha hua hai.
Woh saamaan main ne kal hi khareeda tha.
Woh bag mere kamre mein rakha hua tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Woh ek kala bag hai jis par mera naam likha hua hai.
questions.translatedSentence: It is a black bag with my name written on it.

questions.sentence: Mera bag train mein reh gaya hai, lekin mujhe seat number yaad hai.
options: My bag was left on the train, but I remember the seat number.
My bag was left at the hotel, but I remember the room number.
My bag is on the train, so I remembered to take the seat number.
questions.correctAnswer: My bag was left on the train, but I remember the seat number.

questions.sentence: Maaf kijiye, kya aap meri madad kar sakte hain?
options: Ji zaroor, batayiye kya baat hai.
Ji nahin, mujhe madad ki zaroorat nahin hai.
Shukriya, main bilkul theek hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji zaroor, batayiye kya baat hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Of course, tell me what the matter is.

questions.sentence: Main ne do ghante intezaar kiya lekin koi madad nahin mili.
options: I waited for two hours but got no help.
I waited for two hours before someone finally helped me.
I asked for help twice but nobody came.
questions.correctAnswer: I waited for two hours but got no help.

questions.sentence: Agar train aur late ho gayi to aap kya karenge?
options: Agar train aur late hui to main bus se chala jaunga.
Train late nahin hoti kyunki mausam saaf hai.
Main ne kal hi is train ka ticket khareed liya tha.
questions.correctAnswer: Agar train aur late hui to main bus se chala jaunga.
questions.translatedSentence: If the train gets any later, I will go by bus.

questions.sentence: Agar aaj ki flight nahin gayi to hum kal subah niklenge.
options: If today's flight does not go, we will leave tomorrow morning.
If today's flight is late, we will wait at the airport.
Today's flight did not go, so we left the next morning.
questions.correctAnswer: If today's flight does not go, we will leave tomorrow morning.

questions.sentence: Aap ne shikayat likhwai ya nahin?
options: Haan, main ne daftar mein shikayat likhwa di hai.
Nahin, kyunki mujhe daftar ka raasta maloom hai.
Haan, main ne station par do ghante intezaar kiya.
questions.correctAnswer: Haan, main ne daftar mein shikayat likhwa di hai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have filed a complaint at the office.

questions.sentence: Meherbani kar ke mujhe bata dijiye ke agli bus kab niklegi.
options: Please tell me when the next bus will leave.
Please tell me where the next bus will stop.
Please ask them when the last bus left.
questions.correctAnswer: Please tell me when the next bus will leave.
